posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Ok so we have a few more pieces. Who is left in the artwork that we still don't know? Lets speculate.

1) We have the yellow/orange armor guys found scattered throughout a bunch of decks. 

Prediction: These guys could be related to Biomancer in addition to the robot look-a-likes we see in Argents deck and Legacys in Tactics. But my money is on them being the invasion force of our big bad cosmic entity.

2) We have the man on Expats "Quick Draw" and in the Sentinels deck "Hipocratic Oath"

Prediction: Expats Father!

3) The Soloman Grundy-esque frankenstien guy seen in Tachyons "Lightspeed Barrage" and in Wraiths Tactics cards

Prediction: I have no idea whatsoever.

4) We have the giant red guy seen in Tempests "Flash Flood" and in the Sentinels "Coordinated Assault"

Prediction: Geeze these are getting hard. No clue. Thought he might have been a gene bound something, but am not sure this is the case at all

5) We have the Sabertooth-esque guy found in Visionary's "Suggestion" as well as Beacons Tactics cards

Prediction: Hello? Mcfly? Anyone home? Again, not a single idea.

6) The "golden" outline of a villain found on Rook City Wraiths incap side

Prediction: Yeah...might be the soloman grundy dude...but I have serious doubts about that. I just didn't want to not have another guess.

7) The robot(s) with a green glowing brain found in KNYFE's deck (and possibly others)

Prediction: Could be related to the Host or our Cosmic Entity. Hard to tell. But they have cosmic-y roots for sure

8) We have the spaceman seen in Sentinels "Black Out"

Prediction: We know his name (I think). It's Riot Ray (flavor text in Beacons Tactics cards). But where he fits in is anyones guess.

9) The black creature in Setbacks "Cause and Effect"

Prediction: I think this is obviously Writhe gone horribly wrong (see his incap art).

10) Ninjas in KNYFE's deck

Prediction: I think these guys are connected to Zhu Long/Operative/Heartbreaker. Like a "League of Shadows" type organization

 

Have I missed any big ones? There will be a few added to this list when WotC goes live as well.

There is A LOT of ground to cover here in just two expansions. Like, a metric butt ton of characters and story to be explored. What do you guys think? Do I have it right? Wrong? Got a guess where I failed miserably?

The main reason I feel this way is Omnitron-X's "Defensive Blast". It's true that not all flavor text matches with the art, but if we are going off the assumption that it does in this case, the picture becomes pretty interesting. The quote is from the comic "Terminus" (which I speculate might end up being the name of either the final expansion and/or our big cosmic bad). X says something to the tune of "End times?
